notes: S20PacketEntityProperties(id, getAttributeInstanceSet()) carries every dirty watched instance (movementSpeed and maxHealth for a player) with func_111122_c's whole modifier set, the unsaved sprint boost included; handleEntityProperties sets the base and replaces the client's modifiers with the packet's, so an S20 can strip the client's own sprint boost while its sprinting flag stays on. Natively the server player's movementSpeed modifiers are the sprint flag and the living twin's slowness and speed effects (Potion.func_111183_a: amount times amplifier + 1); potion_apply_attributes and potion_remove_attributes mark the twin's attr_watch_dirty as applyModifier and removeModifier flag the instance. server_player_tick is the player's own EntityTrackerEntry pass (updateFrequency 2): func_111190_b runs on an even entry tick, or when the data watcher changed since the last pass (sp_watched: flags, air, health, potion colour and ambience, arrows, absorption, score), so a splash's dirt on an odd tick waits a tick; a C0B's setSprinting flips data watcher 0 and always leaves. The client applies the packet at its next tick and player_move_speed recomputes the value (op-2 modifiers in their HashSet order: slowness, the sprint boost, speed). maxHealth's modifier (health boost) is unreachable: no source in survival with brewing off. idx-slowness-s1 (a witch's slowness splash on an odd entry tick, deferred) fails at row 93 with the parity model removed, and both recordings fail at row 94 with the potion modifiers dropped; idx-slowness2-s1 is the even tick; both also drink a speed potion and milk.
